source: HAM10000 (Tschandl et al., 2018), Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/DBW86T, CC BY-NC 4.0
preprocessing: short side to 256 (PIL bicubic, antialiased), center crop 224
split_rule: by lesion_id, stratified by class: test 20%, validation 10% of each class's images, the rest training; budgets take one image per lesion before any lesion's second image
